text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Goooo for it!
Satono Crowwwn!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, I knew it.
The Kikka stage is too long for me.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I had a chance of winning.
I even prepared for it! And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Why is it so hard to run here...?!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...... ngh.
...Ngh... Ah, dammit... I blew it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (――What was the reason for today's defeat?)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oof... Didn't work out, huh, Crown.
The aptitude barrier really is rough...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, it was a great race. Thrilling right to the very end!
And besides—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Kitasan Black!
Great tenacity out there!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I'm lookin' forward to your next race too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so much!!
Thank you for cheering me on!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is fine.
If I keep this up, I'll...――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —The harder you push yourself, the more dreams they'll entrust to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (—I see. Her passion is making me...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Kikuka Sho.
Today was used both as a rest day
and as time to organize information.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Kitasan Black.
Her next race: the grand racing festival, the Arima Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Could I get her data for the Satsuki Sho
and the Derby once more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using the laptop in front of me, I send
Kitasan Black's data to Satono Crown's address.
choice_data_list: By the way, why do you need Kitasan's data?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A different Umamusume claimed victory this time.
If we are to devise a strategy for next year, it shouldn't be for Kitasan Black, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just curious, that's all.
And also—just to give it a try."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...There. The analysis is in.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The Satono medical and AI teams
have joined forces to develop an app.
It assesses an Umamusume's growth period through skeletal analysis—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Huh?
Is this really the conclusion we've come to~?
choice_data_list: So, what did the analysis show?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black is in the middle of a growth spurt—"She won't reach her peak until next spring or later."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"She's like a butterfly that has only just emerged from its cocoon.
Her wings are still unstable.
By tomorrow, she will surely evolve even further."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words, even if we prepare for how Kitasan is now,
there's no telling if we can beat tomorrow's Kitasan."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she has it.
After all, she's "extraordinary" too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I told you before, didn't I?
Kita-san's the type who stands right at the center of an era."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Meaning that the time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think, Trainer?
Another monster of the generation is about to be born."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...The Twinkle Series is
quite fascinating, isn't it?
